name: geba-skills
description: Geert Baeke's Claude Code skills: one plugin per skill, install only what you need

plugins.name: drawio-diagram
plugins.description: Light-themed draw.io diagrams in a consistent house style (architecture, pipelines, Azure resource groups with Azure icons), generated from Python and checked by rendering to PNG

plugins.name: app-blueprint
plugins.description: Scaffold, extend or tidy up full-stack apps: FastAPI + uv + ruff + pyright, React/Vite SPA with a generated API client, PostgreSQL + Alembic, optional WorkOS sign-in, Azure Container Apps via Bicep, one quality gate shared with CI

plugins.name: deep-agent-a2a
plugins.description: Scaffold LangChain Deep Agents served over A2A: reusable A2A wrapper (streaming, progress, approvals), MCP tools, PostgreSQL + PgBouncer with a database per agent, BFF + web UI, smoke and load tests, in Docker Compose
